description: Create a new SketchXFlow design with one empty canvas page, to draw on with sketchxflow_canvas_apply using YOUR OWN model — SketchXFlow generates nothing and charges no coins. Returns the project id and the editor link (open it to watch; switch on "Connect an agent" in the editor so it shows each change live). Use kind "mobile" for an app screen.
name: sketchxflow_canvas_create
title: Create a blank canvas design
